Nadia: quick postmortem follow-up  action items for the KV-eviction pattern. We need: (A) a reproducible regression harness, (B) an incident-derived promptset + evals, (C) staged burst load profiles, and (D) a scoped chaos drill. Assign owners and deadlines below.
Owen: I can own the regression harness + CI integration. Plan: fast subset on PRs, full nightly on main. ETA 2025-04-03. Will tag tests with severity (critical/high/medium).
Lina: i'll extract prompts from the incident traces and create golden-response examples. target ~24 prompts covering truncated-prefix, kv-miss cascades, and token-skew cases. ETA 2025-04-09. i'll also add small repro scripts.
Marcus: i'll do staging load jobs and run the first chaos drill (controlled failover). Proposal: weekly spike runs (Wed 00:00 UTC) + monthly cross-region drill with a small blast radius. ETA infra-as-code 2025-04-14.
Nadia: nice. decisions: critical/high tests block releases; medium advisory only. Digest rule: if the kv-eviction-pattern shows >=3 occurrences in 14 days, create a pattern-watch ticket and notify eng-sre.
Owen: detector rule i'll prototype: eviction_rate > 4% AND p95_latency >= 2x -> create digest row. snippet: ```yaml
detector:
  name: eviction_spike_detector
  rule: "eviction_rate > 0.04 and p95_latency >= 2.0*baseline_p95"
  notify: ["#eng-sre","ticketing"]
```
Lina: for the evals harness i'll include both perf and quality checks (p95, token-drop-rate, and response-overlap). i'll store artifacts in gs://evals-artifacts/kv-eviction and build a tiny dash.
RemedyBot: created ticket REM-8101 "KV eviction regression harness" -> Owen, due 2025-04-03.
RemedyBot: created ticket REM-8102 "KV-eviction promptset & evals" -> Lina, due 2025-04-09.
RemedyBot: created ticket REM-8103 "Staging burst profile & chaos drill" -> Marcus, due 2025-04-14.
Marcus: chaos drill checklist (draft): preflight health checks, disable autoscale? NO, keep autoscale but throttle traffic; canary fallback mapping, abort cmd list, pager list, observable thresholds. will post runbook PR before infra commit.
Owen: CI job names: releases/kv-evict/{pr,nightly} so we can aggregate history. sample GH action for PR checks: ```yaml
name: kv-evict-pr-checks
on: pull_request
jobs:
  run-fast:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: ./ci/run_kv_eviction.sh --subset fast
```
Nadia: good. gating detail: automated block if any test with severity >= high fails on main. Ops will have final override for emergency releases.
Lina: i'll tag prompts with severity and root-cause labels (kv-eviction, kv-miss, mem-pressure) so we can roll up trends into the weekly digest. i'll also include minimal repro scripts in the promptset repo.
Owen: i'll wire regression outputs into the release dashboard and add history retention for 90 days. also will add a flakiness metric: if nightly failing rate > 10% for high tests, alert oncall.
Nadia: scheduling a 30m sync on 2025-03-31 11:00 UTC to review first PRs and promptset. calendar invite will go to owners.
Marcus: +1 for sync. note on blast radius: first month small (canary-only), second month test controlled cutover. will include manual abort steps.
RemedyBot: calendar event created "KV-eviction remediation sync" 2025-03-31 11:00 UTC -> Nadia, Owen, Lina, Marcus.
Owen: small follow-up: do we want to gate releases immediately or wait until the harness reaches a coverage threshold? i'd suggest advisory for 2 weeks then enable blocking for high/critical once coverage >= 80% of the incident trace cases.
Nadia: agreed. make it advisory initially and switch to blocking after we hit the coverage metric. add coverage-check to the nightly job.
Lina: noted. i'll add coverage metadata to the promptset so we can measure the percent of incident cases covered.
Marcus: will add runbook link in the ticket and include the rollback command snippets in infra PR.
Nadia: thanks everyone 44d. please update your tickets with status and blockers. we'll use the pattern-watch digest to decide if this requires a remediation sprint.
Owen: will open first PR by EOD tomorrow.
Lina: starting prompt extraction today.
Marcus: infra PR stubbed this week.
RemedyBot: reminder scheduled: 2025-03-31 11:00 UTC  "KV-eviction remediation sync" (invite sent).
